title: MaiCare
description: An AI front desk for clinics, helping patients book, reschedule, or cancel visits in English and Vietnamese.
detail: It offers available appointment times, asks for confirmation before booking, and hands unfinished requests to clinic staff with the conversation attached.

title: PageGuide Gemini

title: Shotcard
description: A macOS shortcut that turns screenshots of Japanese text into explanations and Anki cards, with furigana and audio.
